transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’m here because things are slipping at work. I’ll start follow-up tasks after audits or mentoring events, meaning to finish them, and then a few days later I realize the final email or review note or form just… never got done. It’s been happening enough that I thought I should talk to someone.
Do you find yourself easily distracted while working on these tasks?

Yes. I mean… pretty easily. If I’m reviewing an audit file, a Slack message pops up, or I hear people talking outside my office, and I’m just off track. Sometimes it’s not even outside stuff—it can be some random thought, like about marathon training, and then I’ve lost the thread.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things in your daily life?
I don’t think so… not more than normal, anyway. I mean, I worry about work when something’s due, but I wouldn’t say I’m worried all the time.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're sitting still?
Yeah… I guess so. In meetings especially, I’m usually tapping my foot under the table or clicking a pen. I shift around a lot too. One colleague has joked she can hear my leg going.
Do you often feel anxious?
Not especially, no. I mean, I get tense if something’s urgent or I’m behind, but I wouldn’t say I feel anxious most of the time.
Do you often feel guilty or criticize yourself for not completing tasks or making mistakes?

Yes… I do. I get pretty hard on myself when I realize I didn’t finish something I meant to. Like after audits or mentorship events, I’ll start the follow-up items and think I’m handling them, and then a few days later I find out the final email or review note or form just… never got done. That’s actually part of why I made this appointment.
Do you often feel sad or depressed?
Not really… I mean, I have bad days, sure, but I wouldn’t say I often feel sad or depressed.
Have you had problems with paying attention or following through on instructions for as long as you can remember?

Yes… I think so. Even back in elementary school, my report cards would say I was bright, but I lost assignments or rushed through details. I’d talk out of turn sometimes and need reminders to finish things. My mom still jokes that I could do well on a test and then forget a project sitting in my backpack.
Do you ever avoid starting tasks because you feel overwhelmed by them?
I’m not sure. I mean… sometimes I put things off, but I don’t always know if it’s because I’m overwhelmed or just not ready to deal with it.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when there's no apparent reason to worry?
I don’t think so. I mean, I worry about normal things, work and bills and all that, but not usually for no reason.
Do you frequently have trouble relaxing or calming down when you're not actively working on something?

Yeah… I guess I do. Like on weekends I’ll say I’m going to relax, but then I end up going from laundry to checking email to going for a run to some volunteer planning thing. I don’t really stop until I’m worn out.
Do you often put off tasks because they make you feel anxious or uncomfortable?
I’m not really sure. I do put things off, but I don’t know that I’d call it anxiety exactly. Sometimes I just… don’t want to deal with it.
Do you often feel afraid or fearful for no specific reason?
No… not really. I don’t think I feel afraid out of nowhere. If I’m worried, there’s usually something specific behind it.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when everything seems to be going well?
I don’t think so. I mean, I worry when there’s something to worry about, but if things are actually going fine, I don’t usually sit there looking for problems.
Do you often have a general feeling of anxiety or worry that persists even when there's nothing specific causing it?
Not really, no. I don’t think I have that kind of ongoing worry when nothing’s actually happening.
